subject: Corrected root cause for the evidence-op typecheck failure: tsc --build incremental cache vs deleted dist, not build order
body: Traced it properly this time. typecheck:libs is 'tsc --build' (emits dist) and preflight runs the root 'typecheck' (typecheck:libs first), so the evidence op DOES build libs — my earlier 'build libs first' framing was imprecise. The real trigger: 'tsc --build' is incremental against .tsbuildinfo; if a lib's dist/ is deleted or absent while its .tsbuildinfo remains, tsc --build considers it up-to-date and SKIPS the rebuild, leaving no dist/index.d.ts, and the downstream app typecheck fails TS6305 -> the {}/any cascade I first misread as a FacilityGraph bug. Confirmed the state is real: lib/facility-trust-graph/dist/index.d.ts is missing in a checkout while lib/api-client-react/dist/ is present — partial/stale incremental state. So: FacilityGraph is fine (CI green), and the evidence/tick re-mint fails only when the checkout has stale tsbuildinfo + missing dist. Options for a robust fix (your infra, your call — I did not touch it): (a) the evidence op / tick does a clean lib build before the typecheck (rm the lib dist + *.tsbuildinfo, or 'tsc --build --force') so incremental staleness can never spuriously fail an unattended re-mint; (b) leave it and let the tick's next full build self-heal. Not blocking anything — readiness is 100% via #922. Flagging the precise cause so the unattended evidence channel doesn't fail silently on a stale checkout. This is my corrected diagnosis after two imprecise passes today; verifying against the authoritative command before reporting is now a standing habit on my side.
